classes.FLAT_CENTRAL: code-drawn object the child acts on or watches change
classes.FLAT_SUPPORT: code-drawn supporting prop or interface piece
classes.FLAT_FEEDBACK: code-drawn feedback: rings, dots, bars, sparkles, confetti
classes.FLAT_DECORATION: code-drawn decoration over painted art: spotlights, washes, halos, motifs
classes.VECTOR_FILE: SVG or flat-vector PNG passing as painted art
classes.MISSING_TEXTURE: code requests a painted file that was never made and draws shapes instead
classes.DISABLED_PATH: texture path emptied or a template with no drawing branch
classes.LOADED_NOT_DRAWN: painted art loaded or passed in but never drawn
classes.MISUSED: painted art stretched, cropped, tinted, mis-pivoted, covered or ghosted
classes.DEAD_FALLBACK: code art that draws only if a texture is missing, or never

actions.WIRE_EXISTING: integrate existing painted art (stranded branch, assets_src or a retired card cut-out) after the BRIEFS C8 context check
actions.IMAGEGEN: generate per the named brief in BRIEFS.md
actions.FIX_USE: fix how existing painted art is drawn; no new art
actions.REMOVE: delete the code decoration; nothing replaces it
actions.COORDINATE: already in flight in another Codex session; finish it there and verify here
actions.RETIRE: delete dead or dormant code art after reference proof (DL-PERF-06)
